'''Dootu Mu Bacha''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] engineer living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] around [[3641 BBY]], when he was [[Death/Legends|killed]].

==Behind the scenes==
Dootu Mu Bacha appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. He is not directly involved in any quests, however he can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
